questions.question: Please add a separate Heads-up row for the caveat that the panel does not yet check whether a run used its pinned effort. The existing Heads-up rows do not cover it; the caveat must also remain in the summary.
What do the staffing recommender, trend checkpoint, frontier and mid tiers, and artifact classes mean here? The record names them without supplying their meanings.

A faithful split needs four sentences: nothing changes in this pull request; the verdict schema lives in another skill; it is outside this change; the work-item notes carry the missing halt reason for a follow-on item. The limit is two sentences. Which named claim will you move?
What does a reviewer's tier mean, and what distinguishes a sweep from another review round? The record does not define those terms.
Which five files are meant by 'the five named files'? This reply is read alone, and the record does not supply the complete five-file list.

A faithful split needs two sentences, but together with the required explanation of change_diffs it can fit the reply limit. May the explanation identify change_diffs as the function computing reviewer diff files? The record describes its behavior but does not explicitly identify its kind.

A faithful split of the independent assertions needs three sentences: the watchdog-killed attempt leaves no output; it is a run that died; the message assigns dead-run for that case and transport-error otherwise. The limit is two sentences. Which named claim will you move?

A faithful split needs three sentences: the MAX_ATTEMPTS comment no longer argues for another model on the same vendor; it now explains the transport and model declarations; the same argument is gone from check_route's docstring. The limit is two sentences. Which named claim will you move?

A faithful split needs four sentences: harvest.md identifies the attempts-exhausted refusal as carrying halt guidance; the off-ladder sentence is unchanged; each case has one sentence; the cases no longer overlap. The limit is two sentences. Which named claim will you move?
